svg.title: Orchard grower — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as orchard grower, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A broad apple with a short stem and leaf rises from a tapered fruit-picking basket. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
